description: 高速道路の利用状況 [roads, bridges and tunnels] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 大分市. 大分市の高速道路の利用状況の情報です。. Coverage: 大分市. The portal files it under the publisher 大分市. Its tags are 大分市. It offers 10 resource(s) in xls, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-09-09 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
